name: ideon
description: Your project is scattered across too many tools. Map the chaos on an infinite canvas where notes, files, TO-DOs (and more!) finally live together.
readme_summary: Ideon is a self-hosted visual workspace that allows users to organize projects, notes, and tasks on an infinite canvas. It replaces traditional folder structures with spatial organization, enabling real-time collaboration and historical tracking of workspace evolution.
key_features: Live Integrations with Git platforms (GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo)
Support for Markdown notes, images, links, and files
Time Travel feature for historical snapshots
primary_use_case: To provide a unified, visual, and collaborative workspace for managing projects, code repositories, notes, and tasks, replacing scattered tools and abstract folder structures.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, sprawling mind map depicted as a celestial nebula in deep space. Each star and planet within the nebula represents a different project element: code repositories are glowing orbs with orbiting lines, notes are shimmering parchment scrolls, and tasks are small, interconnected constellations. A central, glowing nexus labeled 'Ideon' acts as the gravitational center, with ethereal beams of light connecting all elements. Subtle UI elements, like floating windows showing code snippets or task lists, are embedded within the nebula. The overall mood is one of organized complexity and interconnectedness, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a cosmic color palette and a sense of infinite depth.

name: domainsearcher-app
description: Score and choose the best domain name for your startup — AI-powered generation, real-time availability, and multi-dimensional scoring (LEN, PRO, MEM, BRD, FIT). Free, no signup.
readme_summary: DomainSearcher is a free, browser-based tool that helps users find and select the best domain name for their startup. It uses AI to generate domain name candidates based on a startup idea, checks their real-time availability across various TLDs, and scores them on multiple criteria like length, pronounceability, memorability, brandability, and fit with the app idea.
key_features: Multi-dimensional scoring (LEN, PRO, MEM, BRD, ZON, FIT)
Bundled AI provider key (Groq) with option for custom keys
primary_use_case: Helping entrepreneurs and startups find and objectively choose the most suitable domain name for their new venture.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, old librarian meticulously organizing a vast library of glowing, ethereal scrolls, each representing a potential domain name. The librarian uses a magnifying glass that highlights key attributes like 'Pronounceability' and 'Brandability' on the scrolls. In the background, a digital interface subtly displays a list of available TLDs and a 'Score' button. The overall scene is a blend of a traditional library and a modern digital workspace, symbolizing the intelligent curation and selection of domain names. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a warm, inviting color palette and soft lighting, emphasizing clarity and organization.

name: logocreator
description: A free + OSS logo generator powered by Flux on Together AI
readme_summary: LogoCreator is an open-source, AI-powered logo generator that allows users to design and export brand-ready logos and full brand kits in seconds. It operates on a free, account-less model, leveraging advanced AI models for generation and editing.
key_features: Support for AI model edits (Flux.1 Kontext)
Radix UI primitives and Tailwind CSS for UI
primary_use_case: Quickly generating professional logos and brand assets using AI, with an emphasis on ease of use and accessibility.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical, magical workshop where a friendly robot artisan is rapidly assembling intricate, glowing logos from abstract streams of colorful light. One stream represents a user's simple text input (like 'BrandName'), another represents style preferences (like 'modern' or 'playful'), and the robot's tools are shaping these into polished, professional logos. Surrounding the robot are neatly organized boxes labeled 'Brand Kit' from which brand elements like color palettes and typography emerge. Subtle UI elements resembling a clean, modern interface are visible on floating screens. The overall mood is creative and efficient, with a touch of futuristic magic. 3D isometric illustration style with vibrant colors and soft lighting.
